messages:
Noah Rivera: heads-up — VelaMetrics onboarding: nightly batch jobs (long-context) are tripping our p95 SLA. seeing short bursts of 1.1s extra latency during imports.
Priya Rao: thanks. any seq_len distribution or traces? could be kv-cache churn or oversized batches.
Noah Rivera: quick histogram: 85% at 2-4k tokens, 12% at 6-9k, ~3% above 10k. traces show cache misses during backfills.
Liam Chen: short-term fix options: 1) route long-context imports to a separate pool with model variant gptx-medium; 2) enable int8 quant profile on that pool; 3) add time-window routing to limit impact on interactive traffic.
Samira Ali: customer priority is predictable SLA for renewals. want to avoid quality regressions. can we canary?
Priya Rao: yes — recommend 5% canary for 24h: route 5% of import traffic to int8 + gptx-medium, compare latency, cost, and run a small quality eval (~3k prompts).
Liam Chen: I'll set up a pre-spin autoscale to warm 2 GPUs 20m before their 01:00-04:00 import window and cap concurrency to avoid noisy neighbors.
Noah Rivera: draft routing snippet for Console please so I can share in the enablement call tomorrow.
Priya Rao: paste this into Console -> Routes:
```json
{"match":"meta.job == \"bulk_import\"","route":"pool: vela-dedicated","time_window":"01:00-04:00","fallback":"hosted-us","transform":"model_override:gptx-medium;quant_profile:int8-light"}
```
Samira Ali: perfect. I'll tell them we will run the 24h canary and review results before full rollout. adding a renewal risk note to the account.
ops-bot: Task created: CS-2389 "VelaMetrics long-imports canary + int8 route" - https://console.redwood.ai/tasks/CS-2389
Noah Rivera: next steps: (1) Priya deploys route draft as disabled (2) Liam configures autoscale & pre-spin (3) enable 5% canary for 24h, gather token cost, latency, and eval diffs (4) review on enablement call tomorrow 10:00 PT.
Samira Ali: 10:00 PT works. adding AM and their lead data engineer.
Priya Rao: will drop the draft route into the shared doc and include a quick evaluation checklist.
Noah Rivera: I'll post canary metrics back here after 24h. thanks team — proactive rec documented in the playbook and renewal notes.
